meta.title: beautifulreact — Dataflow: browser storage and HTTP

cards.title: The only client-side persistence
items: browser storage holds the credential: an httpOnly cookie or a token in memory — never a secret in the bundle, because a bundled key is public
the query cache holds server state in memory, keyed by a stable serializable key; it is a cache, not a database
the app writes no durable data of its own: the backend owns the state

cards.title: Where the data actually lives
items: the Backend API is the system of record: it validates, authorizes and returns DTOs
the SDK normalizes HTTP into a typed union — the envelope { error: { code, message, requiredPermission?, correlationId } } becomes a value, never a thrown string
the ViewModel maps each code to a screen state and renders it; the View only draws

cards.title: Nothing durable in the browser
items: a reload empties the cache: the screen refetches and shows the loading state again
the query key carries every input the query depends on — a key that omits the search term serves the wrong entry
after a mutation the layer invalidates by prefix instead of refetching the world

cards.title: The data that must not leak
items: a client error is reported without personal data: no token, no payload, only the correlation id
server data is untrusted: it can carry markup, a hostile file name or a redirect, so it is sanitized at the boundary
URLs are validated before rendering: allowlist https:, mailto: and relative schemes at the boundary
